# FunnelChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasFunnelChart` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasFunnelChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasFunnelChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasFunnelChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A staged process that shrinks step by step

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasFunnelChart](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasFunnelChart.md)
- [UltraCanvasPyramidChart](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasPyramidChart.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasFunnelChart> CreateFunnelChart( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasFunnelChart> CreateFunnelChartWithData( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height, std::shared_ptr<FunnelDataSource> data, const std::string& title = "");
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasFunnelChart(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onStageClick` | `std::function<void(size_t stageIndex)> onStageClick` | Indices are into the data source, so sorting never shifts them |
| `onStageHover` | `std::function<void(size_t stageIndex)> onStageHover` | _Stage hover_ |
| `onConnectorClick` | `std::function<void(size_t upperStageIndex)> onConnectorClick` | upperStageIndex is the stage above the neck that was clicked |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md): `SetCustomTooltipGenerator`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### struct `FunnelSubSegment`

One slice of a stage, used to break a stage down by channel, region, product or whatever else splits the population arriving at that step.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `std::string label` |  |
| `value` | `double value` |  |
| `color` | `Color color` | Transparent = shade the stage colour by position |

### struct `FunnelStage`

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `stageLabel` | `std::string stageLabel` | "Viewed", "Add to Cart", ... |
| `stageValue` | `double stageValue` | Population reaching this stage |
| `description` | `std::string description` | Long-form annotation drawn beside the stage |
| `badgeText` | `std::string badgeText` | Short marker drawn outside the stage, e.g. "01" |
| `stageColor` | `Color stageColor` | Transparent = take the colour from the colour mode |
| `targetValue` | `double targetValue` | &lt;= 0 disables the target overlay for this stage |
| `tooltipText` | `std::string tooltipText` | Optional custom tooltip replacing the generated one. Tooltips are rendered as Pango markup: the generated text escapes &, &lt; and &gt; for you, but text supplied here is passed through verbatim so it can carry markup. |
| `segments` | `std::vector<FunnelSubSegment> segments` | Empty = solid stage |

Methods: `HasSegments`, `GetSegmentTotal`

### struct `FunnelStageMetrics`

Everything the chart derives about one stage from its neighbours. Computed on demand rather than stored, so editing a value can never leave it stale.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | `double value = 0.0` |  |
| `percentOfFirst` | `double percentOfFirst = 100.0` | Share of the stage at the top of the funnel |
| `percentOfPrevious` | `double percentOfPrevious = 100.0` | Conversion from the stage above |
| `percentOfTotal` | `double percentOfTotal = 0.0` | Share of every stage added together |
| `dropOff` | `double dropOff = 0.0` | Absolute loss since the stage above |
| `dropOffPercent` | `double dropOffPercent = 0.0` | 100 - percentOfPrevious |

### enum `FunnelShapeMode`

X11 pollutes the global namespace with None, Above, Below, Always and friends, so every enumerator below carries a descriptive suffix.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `SegmentedBars` | Detached bars joined by tapering connector necks |
| `ContinuousFunnel` | One solid funnel, slabs touching edge to edge |
| `CardRows` | Rounded row cards with the wedge running through them |
| `SkewedInfographic` | Sheared presentation slabs with badges and callouts |
| `BarStyleFunnel` | Plain diminishing bars - the accessible variant |

### enum `FunnelOrientation`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `VerticalFunnel` | Flows top to bottom |
| `HorizontalFunnel` | Flows left to right |

### enum `FunnelScaleMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `WidthProportional` | Stage breadth tracks the value |
| `HeightProportional` | Stage thickness tracks the value, breadth tapers evenly |
| `AreaProportional` | Slab area tracks the value - the honest funnel |
| `EqualStages` | Every stage the same size, a pure pipeline diagram |

### enum `FunnelTipMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `PointTip` | Funnel closes to a point past the last stage |
| `FlatNeck` | Funnel closes to a neck of SetNeckRatio() width |
| `MinWidthTip` | Last stage keeps its own breadth, no closing taper |

### enum `FunnelAlignment`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `CenterAligned` |  |
| `StartAligned` | Left in vertical mode, top in horizontal mode |
| `EndAligned` |  |

### enum `FunnelColorMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `SequentialRamp` | Interpolate between two colours down the funnel |
| `CategoricalPalette` | Cycle a palette, one colour per stage |
| `SingleHue` | One colour throughout |
| `PerStageOverride` | Only what each stage sets, base colour otherwise |
| `ThresholdColor` | Colour by conversion against the configured thresholds |

### enum `FunnelValuePolicy`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `AllowIncrease` | Draw whatever was given, even if a stage grows |
| `ClampToPrevious` | A stage never draws wider than the one above it |
| `AutoSortDescending` | Reorder so the funnel always narrows |

### struct `FunnelStageGeometry`

One entry per drawn stage, rebuilt with the rendering cache. Rendering, hit testing and label placement all read from here so they can never disagree.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `dataIndex` | `size_t dataIndex = 0` | Index into the data source, unaffected by sorting |
| `polygon` | `std::vector<Point2Dd> polygon` | Slab outline in element coordinates |
| `bandStart` | `double bandStart = 0.0` | Along the flow axis |
| `bandEnd` | `double bandEnd = 0.0` |  |
| `halfExtentStart` | `double halfExtentStart = 0.0` | Across the flow axis, at bandStart |
| `halfExtentEnd` | `double halfExtentEnd = 0.0` | ... and at bandEnd |
| `center` | `Point2Dd center` | Slab centroid, where inside labels land |
| `color` | `Color color` |  |
| `metrics` | `FunnelStageMetrics metrics` |  |
| `connectorPolygon` | `std::vector<Point2Dd> connectorPolygon` | Neck joining this stage to the next one - empty for the last stage and for shape modes whose slabs already touch. |
| `connectorCenter` | `Point2Dd connectorCenter` |  |
